seen_animation: A figure sits in a wide trapezoid-shaped cloak on the ground line, with trees and a bush in grey behind. The figure has a small oval head under a flat hat brim and one bent arm reaching out to the left from the top of the cloak. In frames 1-4 the hat brim points to the left and the face (two dots and a mouth) faces the viewer. From frames 5-12 the head slowly shifts right and up and the hat tilts so its brim rises toward the upper right. In frames 13-16 the head sits higher and further right on the cloak's top, the hat is tilted steeply, the face is reduced to one or two dots, and the arm reaches further left. The cloak stays in place with only a small drift right and slight narrowing. It reads as the seated figure slowly tilting its head back and turning it.
seen_film: A person wrapped in a large orange cloak or sleeping bag tied with cord sits in snow in front of pine trees, the cloak spreading into a wide tent shape. In frames 1-6 the dark-hooded head is bowed down toward the chest. From frames 7-10 the head lifts and turns to show the face in profile looking to the left of frame. In frames 11-16 the head stays raised in left-facing profile, with a small further settling; the cloak body barely moves and the camera is static.
named_subject: A person with a hat seated inside a large tent-shaped cloak (the doodle's hatted figure with a long body).
evidence: Placement and timing are broadly right: the cloak stays fixed in the lower-left half of frame through e.png 1-50, matching the static seated body in f.png, and the head change happens in the second half (e.png ~20-40) as the film's head lift does (f.png ~20-35). But the action differs in kind: in f.png 1-18 the head is bowed forward and in f.png 25-50 it is lifted and turned into left-facing profile; in e.png 1-12 the head is already upright and facing the viewer, and over e.png 17-40 the change is a rotation of the hat brim from horizontal-left to steeply tilted up-right with the head drifting right, so it reads as the hat tipping back rather than a bowed head rising to look left. No bowed starting pose is drawn. Motion between consecutive e.png frames is gradual; g.png shows an even, gapless drift of the head up and right with no reversals. The hat outline changes proportion between e.png 1 (wide flat brim) and e.png 33-50 (narrow tilted oval), which is gradual, not a pop.
primary_gap: The head never starts bowed and never turns into a left-facing profile, so the film's event (a hunched person lifting their head to look out to the left) is replaced by a front-facing head whose hat tilts back to the right.
closes_when: In e.png 1-18 the head sits low and forward on the cloak top with the hat brim tipped down over the face, and over e.png ~20-35 it rises and the face features (dots, mouth) move to the left side of the head oval with the hat brim pointing left, then holds there to e.png 50.
protect: The fixed cloak position and size matching the film's seated body; the slow, continuous, jump-free head motion (as in g.png); the doodle's stroke habits for the hat brim lines, small oval head with dot eyes, and single bent arm; the plain grey scenery that stays still.
identity_gap: The hat, small dotted head and bent arm match c.png, but the body has been widened from the doodle's narrow upright rounded column into a broad trapezoid, which is the one part that no longer looks like the doodle's own body shape.
